e.title: **把「分布拟合」这件事收成一个界面**：R 包 **FitVerse**（CRAN 1.0-2，2026-09-06 发布）——**52 个分布族 × 三种估计方法**（MLE／矩法／**L-矩**），**AIC／BIC 与三种拟合优度检验自动选优**；**⭐ 每个方法都带一条文献出处（DOI／ISBN）**；**⭐ 而它在 GitHub 上只有一个**只读 CRAN 镜像仓库**，**连 README 都没有**——**登记在 CRAN，文档在 DESCRIPTION**
e.title_en: Collecting distribution fitting into one interface: the R package FitVerse, released on CRAN as 1.0-2 on 2026-09-06, covering 52 distribution families across three estimation methods including L-moments, with automatic best-fit selection by AIC, BIC and three goodness-of-fit tests, attributing every method to a cited source with a DOI or ISBN, while its only GitHub presence is a read-only CRAN mirror repository that carries no README at all, so its documentation lives in the DESCRIPTION and on CRAN rather than in a repository.
e.title_hk: **把「分布擬合」這件事收成一個介面**：R 套件 **FitVerse**（CRAN 1.0-2，2026-09-06 發布）——**52 個分布族 × 三種估計方法**（MLE／矩法／**L-矩**），**AIC／BIC 與三種擬合優度檢定自動選優**；**⭐ 每個方法都帶一條文獻出處（DOI／ISBN）**；**⭐ 而它在 GitHub 上只有一個**唯讀 CRAN 鏡像倉庫**，**連 README 都沒有**——**登記在 CRAN，文件在 DESCRIPTION**
e.summary: **FitVerse**（CRAN 包，`FitVerse` 1.0-2）**是 2026-09-06 发布的一个 R 分布拟合包**：**逐字自述支持**「**52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**」**与三种估计方法**「**Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Method of Moments (MOM), and L-Moments (L-MOM)**」**；**自动选优用** AIC、BIC **与三种拟合优度检验**（Kolmogorov-Smirnov、Anderson-Darling、Cramer-von Mises）；**并逐字自述服务对象包括**「**survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows**」。**本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处」**，**它同时是两端的好样本**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出处**——**每一个方法都带一条可核查的文献**（**L-矩** Hosking 1990 **附 DOI**、**Hosking and Wallis 1997 附 ISBN**；**AIC** Akaike 1974 **附 DOI**；**BIC** Schwarz 1978 **附 DOI**；**bootstrap 区间** Efron and Hastie 2016 **附 ISBN**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 登记**——**它在 GitHub 上只有一个**只读 CRAN 镜像仓库 `cran/FitVerse`**（**实测 2026-09-06／07 推送、2026-09-01 创建、★0、无 README**），**真正的文档是** DESCRIPTION **与 CRAN 页**——**⭐ 即**一个包**完全可以只登记在 CRAN**，**而**不拥有一个开发仓库**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它接在池内已有的四个包上**：`Imports` **实测含** `actuar`（≥3.1.0）、`fitdistrplus`（≥1.1.0）、`lmomco`（≥2.3.7）、`evd`（≥2.3.3），**而** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有条目**。**⚠️ 本次未安装 R、未运行该包、未读其参考手册**，**故不主张**任何拟合结果、选优结论或数值精度。
e.summary_hk: **FitVerse**（CRAN 套件，`FitVerse` 1.0-2）**是 2026-09-06 發布的一個 R 分布擬合套件**：**逐字自述支援**「**52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**」**與三種估計方法**「**Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Method of Moments (MOM), and L-Moments (L-MOM)**」**；**自動選優用** AIC、BIC **與三種擬合優度檢定**（Kolmogorov-Smirnov、Anderson-Darling、Cramer-von Mises）；**並逐字自述服務對象包括**「**survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows**」。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出處**——**每一個方法都帶一條可核查的文獻**（**L-矩** Hosking 1990 **附 DOI**、**Hosking and Wallis 1997 附 ISBN**；**AIC** Akaike 1974 **附 DOI**；**BIC** Schwarz 1978 **附 DOI**；**bootstrap 區間** Efron and Hastie 2016 **附 ISBN**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 登記**——**它在 GitHub 上只有一個**唯讀 CRAN 鏡像倉庫 `cran/FitVerse`**（**實測 2026-09-06／07 推送、2026-09-01 建立、★0、無 README**），**真正的文件是** DESCRIPTION **與 CRAN 頁**——**⭐ 即**一個套件**完全可以只登記在 CRAN**，**而**不擁有一個開發倉庫**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它接在池內已有的多個套件上**：`Imports` **實測含** `actuar`（≥3.1.0）、`fitdistrplus`（≥1.1.0）、`lmomco`（≥2.3.7）、`evd`（≥2.3.3），**而** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有條目**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 R、未運行該套件、未讀其參考手冊**，**故不主張**任何擬合結果、選優結論或數值精度。
e.summary_en: **FitVerse**, a CRAN package at version 1.0-2, **is an R distribution-fitting package published on 2026-09-06**: verbatim, it **supports 52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**, with three estimation methods, being maximum likelihood, method of moments and L-moments; automatic best-fit selection uses AIC and BIC together with three goodness-of-fit tests, namely Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling and Cramer-von Mises; and its own description names survey sampling, hydrology **and actuarial workflows** as the settings it is designed to support. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and the package is a good sample of both ends**: every method is attributed to a checkable source, with a DOI for the Hosking L-moment paper, ISBNs for the Hosking and Wallis book and the Efron and Hastie book, and DOIs for the Akaike and Schwarz model-selection papers; **and on GitHub its only presence is a read-only CRAN mirror repository**, measured as pushed on 2026-09-06 or 2026-09-07, created 2026-09-01, with no stars and **no README**, so the real documentation is the DESCRIPTION file and the CRAN page, which shows that a package can be registered on CRAN without owning a development repository at all. **It also wires onto packages this wiki already carries**: its Imports field lists actuar, fitdistrplus, lmomco and evd, and `[[fitdistrplus]]`, `[[lmomco]]` and `[[evd]]` already have entries here. **R was not installed this round, the package was not run and its reference manual was not read, so no fitting result, selection outcome or numerical accuracy is claimed.**
e.body:
**FitVerse**（CRAN 包，**版本 1.0-2**）**是一个把「给连续单变量数据拟合参数分布」收成一个界面的 R 包**，**逐字自述为**「**Provides a unified, user-friendly interface for fitting parametric probability distributions to continuous univariate data.**」**。**本次实测的 CRAN 记录**：**`Date/Publication: 2026-09-06 22:40:14 UTC`**、**`Packaged: 2026-09-06 10:55:39 UTC; karunareddy`**、**`License: GPL (>= 3)`**、**`Depends: R (>= 4.1.0)`**、**`NeedsCompilation: no`**、**`RoxygenNote: 7.3.2`**、**`VignetteBuilder: knitr`**；**维护者** `Karuna G. Reddy`（**附 ORCID `0000-0002-9467-4668`**，**单位邮箱为奥克兰大学**），**另一位作者** `M. G. M. Khan`。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去**」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里把「出处」写得最规整的一条**，**也是把「登记」这件事暴露得最彻底的一条**。

**可核实信息（均 CRAN 页、DESCRIPTION 与 r-universe 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 内容是可数的两组**——**逐字**「**52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**」**与**「**three estimation methods: Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Method of Moments (MOM), and L-Moments (L-MOM)**」**；**自动选优逐字为**「**Automatic best-fit selection is performed using AIC, BIC, and goodness-of-fit tests (Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling, Cramer-von Mises (CvM))**」**。**⭐ 即**一个拟合包该说清的三件事**（**候选分布有几族**、**参数怎么估**、**怎么判谁更好**）**都被写成了可数的条目**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 每一个方法都带一条文献出处**——**DESCRIPTION 里逐字**：**L-矩**「**L-moment estimation follows Hosking (1990) <doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1990.tb01775.x> and Hosking and Wallis (1997, ISBN:9780521430456)**」、**AIC**「**Model selection via AIC follows Akaike (1974) <doi:10.1109/TAC.1974.1100705>**」、**BIC**「**follows Schwarz (1978) <doi:10.1214/aos/1176344136>**」、**bootstrap 区间**「**follow Bootstrap confidence intervals follow Efron and Hastie (2016, ISBN:9781107149892)**」。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处写法**：**它没有说「我们用业界标准方法」，而是把每个方法接到一篇具体文献上**（**三条 DOI 加两条 ISBN**）——**⭐ 即**「你用这个方法，你可以去查它是谁提出的、原始定义是什么」**；**本词条在现场核对了这五条标识的形态**（**三条 DOI 前缀与两条 ISBN-13 长度均完整**），**⚠️ 但未打开任何一条链接、未核对文献内容与实现是否一致**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它明确点名了「精算」这一使用场景**——**逐字**：**「**FitVerse is designed to support data characterisation in survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows, where identifying the underlying distribution of a variable is a prerequisite for downstream modelling and inference.**」**。**⭐ 即**它把自己定位为**下游建模的前置步骤**（**先确定变量服从什么分布**），**而不是一个端到端的定价工具**——**这与本站 [[insurance-distributional]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]] 一类条目所讨论的下游工作正好接得上**。**⭐⭐ ④ 产物是可核查的几样**——**逐字**：**每拟合一个模型都产出**「**a publication-quality diagnostic plot: a histogram overlaid with the fitted density curve and the estimated PDF formula annotated directly on the figure**」（**⭐ 即**图上直接标出估计出来的 PDF 公式**，**而不是只画一条曲线**）；**另有** `plotly` **交互版**、**参数估计与** return levels **的 bootstrap 置信区间**、**跨多列的批量拟合**（**逐字说明用于**「**automated workflows and web-upload use cases**」）、**JSON 序列化**（**逐字说明用于接** `Shiny`**）**、**以及自动生成 HTML／PDF 报告**。**⭐ 即**「**结果能不能交给别人**」**被当成一等功能**（**JSON、报告、图上公式三样都是交付物**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它在 GitHub 上只有一个只读镜像，而且没有 README**——**本次实测**：GitHub 仓库 `cran/FitVerse`，**`pushed_at` 为 2026-09-07、`created_at` 为 2026-09-01、★0、语言 R、体量 1 KB**，**其描述逐字为**「**This is a read-only mirror of the CRAN R package repository**」一类的 CRAN 镜像说明；**`README.md` 探测返回 404**（**本次对 `master` 分支实测，文件不存在**）。**⭐ 因此本词条如实指出**：**这个包的文档只存在于** DESCRIPTION **与 CRAN 页**，**仓库里没有 README 可读**——**⭐ 而这正是本轮主题的另一端**：**一个包可以只**登记在 CRAN**，**而**不拥有开发仓库**；**它的「登记」就是它存在的全部形式**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 它在 r-universe 上也被登记了一次**——**本次实测** r-universe 的 `cran/FitVerse` 条目：**`RemoteUrl` 为** `https://github.com/cran/FitVerse`、**`RemoteSha` 为** `8611f2c6e3`、**版本 1.0-2**、**`_registered` 为** `true`、**最近一个月下载数 88**（**来源字段逐字指向** `cranlogs.r-pkg.org`**）**。**⭐ 即**同一个包**在四层登记处各有一份记录**（**CRAN 源包**、**GitHub 只读镜像**、**r-universe 构建条目**、**cranlogs 下载统计**），**而**这四份记录的字段并不完全相同**（**例如 `Date/Publication` 只在 CRAN 与 DESCRIPTION 里有，r-universe 用的是它自己的构建时间戳**）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 它接在池内已有的包上**——`Imports` **逐字含** `actuar (>= 3.1.0)`、`mc2d (>= 0.1.18)`、`evd (>= 2.3.3)`、`sn (>= 2.1.0)`、`fitdistrplus (>= 1.1.0)`、`lmomco (>= 2.3.7)`、`ggplot2 (>= 3.4.0)`、`goftest (>= 1.2.3)`、`gridExtra (>= 2.3)`，**以及** `stats`、`graphics`、`grDevices`、`utils`、`tools`；**其中** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有条目**（**⭐ 即**本站已收录分布拟合这条线上游的三个包**，**本条补上的是把三者收在一个界面下的那一层**）；`Suggests` **逐字含** `shiny`、`bslib`、`DT`、`plotly`、`testthat`、`knitr`、`rmarkdown`、`kableExtra`、`jsonlite`、`base64enc`、`MASS`、`GeneralizedHyperbolic`、`truncnorm`。**⭐ ⑧ 与既有条目的对照**：**本站 [[actuarialmath]]、[[actuariat-python]]、[[loss-data-analytics]]、[[insurance-quantile]] 等条目覆盖相邻工作**，**而本条记录的是另一种取向**：**不重写估计与检验，而是把已有的多个上游包（`actuar`／`evd`／`fitdistrplus`／`lmomco`／`goftest`）编排成一个统一界面并补上交付物（图、报告、JSON）**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「分布拟合这条线在 2026 年 9 月又多了一层封装」的位置说明**；**对损失分布拟合、极值建模与 tail 研究**，**它提供的是一个可数的入口（52 族／3 种估计／3 种检验）**，**而它自己点名的使用场景里也包含 actuarial workflows**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 R、没有安装该包、没有运行任何一次拟合**（**未 `install.packages`、未调用任何函数、未生成任何图或报告**），**故不主张**任何拟合结果、参数估计、选优结论、bootstrap 区间或报告输出**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读其参考手册与 vignette**——**本次只读了** CRAN 页正文、`DESCRIPTION` 全文（**经 `cran/FitVerse` 镜像的 `master` 分支取得**）**与 r-universe 的条目字段**，**故不主张**「52 个分布族」的实际覆盖范围、三种估计方法的具体实现、检验的临界值来源与批量模式的接口。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 五条文献标识本次只核对了形态**（**DOI 前缀与 ISBN-13 长度**），**未打开链接、未核对文献内容与该包实现是否一致**——**「它引用了 Hosking 1990」是本条的实测事实**，**「它按 Hosking 1990 实现了 L-矩」不是**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实其数值正确性**：**未与任何独立实现对照**（**例如 [[lmomco]] 或 [[evd]] 的同一族拟合结果**）；**未核实 AIC／BIC 与三种检验的实现是否有误**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `cran/FitVerse` **是否真是「只读镜像」以及镜像的同步机制**（**本次只读到其描述与文件清单**）；**未核实该包是否有本站尚未发现的开发仓库**（**本次用 GitHub 搜索 `FitVerse` 只命中若干同名 JS 项目**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实 CRAN 上的检查结果**（**未查它的 CRAN check 页**）、**未核实是否有 vignette 与 News**。**⑦ ⚠️ 作者背景只读到 `DESCRIPTION` 里的姓名、邮箱与一个 ORCID**，**未核实**其机构、其他工作或该包的使用范围；**★0 与镜像仓库的星数不构成质量证据**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建日期 2026-09-01 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-06／07 与 CRAN 发布日期 2026-09-06 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「只登记在 CRAN、没有开发仓库的包」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**（**池内 [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] 均以 CRAN 页为来源，但它们各自都有 GitHub 仓库**）。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**FitVerse**（CRAN 套件，**版本 1.0-2**）**是一個把「給連續單變量資料擬合參數分布」收成一個介面的 R 套件**，**逐字自述為**「**Provides a unified, user-friendly interface for fitting parametric probability distributions to continuous univariate data.**」**。**本次實測的 CRAN 記錄**：**`Date/Publication: 2026-09-06 22:40:14 UTC`**、**`Packaged: 2026-09-06 10:55:39 UTC; karunareddy`**、**`License: GPL (>= 3)`**、**`Depends: R (>= 4.1.0)`**、**`NeedsCompilation: no`**、**`RoxygenNote: 7.3.2`**、**`VignetteBuilder: knitr`**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記與出處：讓別人查得到，也讓每個數回得去**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 CRAN 頁、DESCRIPTION 與 r-universe 實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 內容是可數的兩組**——**逐字**「**52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**」**與**「**three estimation methods: Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Method of Moments (MOM), and L-Moments (L-MOM)**」**；**自動選優逐字為**「**AIC, BIC, and goodness-of-fit tests (Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling, Cramer-von Mises (CvM))**」**。**⭐ 即**一個擬合套件該說清的三件事**（**候選分布有幾族**、**參數怎麼估**、**怎麼判誰更好**）**都寫成了可數的條目**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 每一個方法都帶一條文獻出處**——**逐字**：**L-矩**「**follows Hosking (1990) <doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1990.tb01775.x> and Hosking and Wallis (1997, ISBN:9780521430456)**」、**AIC**「**follows Akaike (1974) <doi:10.1109/TAC.1974.1100705>**」、**BIC**「**follows Schwarz (1978) <doi:10.1214/aos/1176344136>**」、**bootstrap 區間**「**follow Efron and Hastie (2016, ISBN:9781107149892)**」。**⭐ 即**它沒有說「我們用業界標準方法」，**而是把每個方法接到一篇具體文獻上**（**三條 DOI ＋ 兩條 ISBN**）；**⚠️ 本次只核對了形態（DOI 前綴與 ISBN-13 長度），未打開鏈接、未核對文獻內容與實作是否一致**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它明確點名了「精算」這一使用場景**——**逐字**：**「**designed to support data characterisation in survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows, where identifying the underlying distribution of a variable is a prerequisite for downstream modelling and inference**」**——**⭐ 即**它把自己定位為**下游建模的前置步驟**。**⭐⭐ ④ 產物是可核查的幾樣**：**逐字**「**a publication-quality diagnostic plot: a histogram overlaid with the fitted density curve and the estimated PDF formula annotated directly on the figure**」（**⭐ 圖上直接標出估計出來的 PDF 公式**）；**另有** `plotly` **互動版**、**參數與** return levels **的 bootstrap 信賴區間**、**跨多列批量擬合**、**JSON 序列化**（**逐字說明用於接** `Shiny`**）**、**自動 HTML／PDF 報告**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它在 GitHub 上只有一個唯讀鏡像，而且沒有 README**——**本次實測**：`cran/FitVerse`，**推送 2026-09-07、建立 2026-09-01、★0、語言 R、體量 1 KB**，**`README.md` 探測 404**。**⭐ 即**這個套件的文件**只存在於** DESCRIPTION **與 CRAN 頁**；**一個套件可以只**登記在 CRAN**，**而**不擁有開發倉庫**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 它在 r-universe 上也被登記了一次**——**`RemoteSha` 為** `8611f2c6e3`、**`_registered` 為** `true`、**最近一個月下載數 88**（**來源逐字指向** `cranlogs.r-pkg.org`**）**；**⭐ 即**同一個套件**在四層登記處各有一份記錄**，**而**四份記錄的欄位並不完全相同**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 它接在池內已有的套件上**——`Imports` **逐字含** `actuar (>= 3.1.0)`、`mc2d (>= 0.1.18)`、`evd (>= 2.3.3)`、`sn (>= 2.1.0)`、`fitdistrplus (>= 1.1.0)`、`lmomco (>= 2.3.7)`、`ggplot2 (>= 3.4.0)`、`goftest (>= 1.2.3)`、`gridExtra (>= 2.3)`；**其中** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有條目**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「分布擬合這條線在 2026 年 9 月又多了一層封裝」的位置說明**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 R、沒有安裝該套件、沒有運行任何一次擬合**，**故不主張**任何擬合結果、參數估計、選優結論、bootstrap 區間或報告輸出**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀其參考手冊與 vignette**——**本次只讀了** CRAN 頁正文、`DESCRIPTION` 全文**與 r-universe 條目欄位**，**故不主張**「52 個分布族」的實際覆蓋、三種估計方法的實作、檢定臨界值來源與批量模式介面。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 五條文獻標識本次只核對了形態**，**未打開鏈接、未核對內容與實作是否一致**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實其數值正確性**：**未與任何獨立實作對照**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** `cran/FitVerse` **是否真是「唯讀鏡像」與其同步機制**；**未核實**是否有本站尚未發現的開發倉庫。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實 CRAN 檢查結果、vignette 與 News**。**⑦ ⚠️ 作者背景只讀到 `DESCRIPTION` 裡的姓名、郵箱與一個 ORCID**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-09-01 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-06／07 與 CRAN 發布日期 2026-09-06 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「只登記在 CRAN、沒有開發倉庫的套件」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。

**FitVerse**, a CRAN package at **version 1.0-2**, **is an R package that collects fitting parametric distributions to continuous univariate data into a single interface**, stating verbatim that it provides a unified, user-friendly interface for fitting parametric probability distributions to continuous univariate data. **The CRAN record measured this round** gives `Date/Publication: 2026-09-06 22:40:14 UTC`, `Packaged: 2026-09-06 10:55:39 UTC; karunareddy`, `License: GPL (>= 3)`, `Depends: R (>= 4.1.0)`, `NeedsCompilation: no`, `RoxygenNote: 7.3.2` and `VignetteBuilder: knitr`, with the maintainer carrying an ORCID. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance: making something findable, and making every number traceable back.**

**Verified information, all measured from the CRAN page, the DESCRIPTION file and the r-universe record**: **first, the content is two countable groups**, verbatim, 52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded and extreme-value shapes, and three estimation methods, maximum likelihood, method of moments and L-moments, with automatic best-fit selection performed using AIC, BIC and Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling and Cramer-von Mises tests. **The three things a fitting package should state, how many candidate families, how parameters are estimated, and how the winner is chosen, are all written as countable items.** **Second, every method is attributed to a source**: L-moment estimation follows Hosking (1990) with a DOI, and Hosking and Wallis (1997) with an ISBN; model selection via AIC follows Akaike (1974) with a DOI; via BIC follows Schwarz (1978) with a DOI; and bootstrap confidence intervals follow Efron and Hastie (2016) with an ISBN. **It does not claim to use industry-standard methods; it wires each method to a specific paper, three DOIs and two ISBNs.** **This round only the form of those five identifiers was checked, their prefixes and lengths, not the linked papers and not whether the implementation matches them.** **Third, it names actuarial work explicitly**, verbatim, as designed to support data characterisation in survey sampling, hydrology and actuarial workflows, where identifying the underlying distribution of a variable is a prerequisite for downstream modelling and inference, **which places it as a step before downstream modelling rather than an end-to-end pricing tool**. **Fourth, the outputs are checkable**: verbatim, every fitted model produces a publication-quality diagnostic plot, a histogram overlaid with the fitted density curve and the estimated PDF formula annotated directly on the figure, **so the estimated formula is printed on the chart rather than only drawn**, plus an optional interactive version through plotly, bootstrap confidence intervals for parameter estimates and return levels, batch fitting across columns for automated workflows and web-upload use cases, JSON serialisation for integration with Shiny, and automated HTML and PDF report generation; **whether the result can be handed to someone else is treated as a first-class feature**. **Fifth, its only GitHub presence is a read-only mirror and it has no README**: the measured repository is pushed on 2026-09-07, created on 2026-09-01, with zero stars, one kilobyte and a description identifying it as a read-only mirror of the CRAN package repository, and a probe for a README returns 404 on the default branch. **So its documentation exists only in the DESCRIPTION and on the CRAN page, which is the other end of this round theme: a package can be registered on CRAN without owning a development repository, and that registration is the entirety of its existence.** **Sixth, it is registered once more on r-universe**, where the measured record pins a commit SHA, reports the package as registered and reports 88 downloads in the last month from cranlogs. **The same package therefore has four separate records across four registries, and those records do not carry identical fields: the CRAN publication timestamp exists in the DESCRIPTION and on CRAN but not in the registry build record.** **Seventh, it wires onto packages this wiki already carries**: its Imports field lists actuar, mc2d, evd, sn, fitdistrplus, lmomco, ggplot2, goftest and gridExtra with version floors, and `[[fitdistrplus]]`, `[[lmomco]]` and `[[evd]]` already have entries here, so this entry supplies the layer that collects three upstream packages under one interface.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[fitdistrplus]], [[lmomco]] and [[evd]]**, because **it records where the distribution-fitting line stood in September 2026 and offers a countable entry point of 52 families, three estimators and three tests**, with actuarial workflows named among its intended uses.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, R was not installed, the package was not installed and no fit was run** — nothing was downloaded, no function was called and no plot or report was produced — **so no fitting result, parameter estimate, selection outcome, bootstrap interval or report output is claimed to work as described**. **Second, its reference manual and vignette were not read**: only the CRAN page text, the full DESCRIPTION file taken from the mirror, and the r-universe record fields were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual coverage of the 52 families, the implementations of the three estimators, where the test critical values come from, or the batch-mode interface; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the five citations were checked only for form**, not opened and not reconciled with the implementation, so that it cites Hosking (1990) is a measured fact while that it implements L-moments as Hosking (1990) defines them is not. **Fourth, numerical correctness was not verified** against any independent implementation, nor were the AIC, BIC and goodness-of-fit implementations checked for error. **Fifth, whether the mirror really is read-only and how it synchronises was not verified**, nor was whether a development repository exists that this round did not find, the GitHub search for FitVerse having returned only unrelated JavaScript projects. **Sixth, its CRAN check results, vignettes and news file were not examined. Seventh, the author details read are only those in the DESCRIPTION: names, addresses and one ORCID; the institutional background, other work and adoption were not checked, and a mirror repository with zero stars is not evidence either way.** **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-09-01 is outside the thaw window while the push and the CRAN publication date of 2026-09-06 are inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a package registered only on CRAN with no development repository had no counterpart in the pool**, since the pooled `fitdistrplus`, `lmomco` and `evd` entries are all sourced from CRAN pages but each of those packages also has a GitHub repository. **Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
